shortDescription: Configure Infoblox NIOS network range object

options.name: comment
options.description: Configures a text string comment to be associated with the instance of this object.  The provided text string will be configured on the object instance.

options.name: disable
options.description: Determines whether a range is disabled or not. When this is set to false, the range is enabled.

options.name: end_addr
options.description: Configures IP address this object instance is to end at. If 'new_end_addr' is defined during a create operation this value is overridden with the value of 'new_end_addr'

options.name: extattrs
options.description: Allows for the configuration of Extensible Attributes on the instance of the object.  This argument accepts a set of key / value pairs for configuration.

options.name: failover_association
options.description: The name of the DHCP failover association which will be configured to server this object instance. A failover of MS or Nios members can be configured. Can not be configured when 'ms_server' or 'member' are configured.

options.name: member
options.description: The hostname of the Nios member which will be configured to server this object instance. Can not be configured when 'ms_server' or 'failover_association' are configured.

options.name: ms_server
options.description: The hostname of the MS member which will be configured to server this object instance. Can not be configured when 'member' or 'failover_association' are configured.

options.name: name
options.description: Congifured the name of the Microsoft scope for the instance of the object on the NIOS server.

options.name: network
options.description: Specifies the network to add or remove DHCP range to.  The value should use CIDR notation.

options.name: network_view
options.description: Configures the name of the network view to associate with this configured instance.

options.name: new_end_addr
options.description: Configures IP address to update this object instance to end at.

options.name: new_start_addr
options.description: Configures IP address to update this object instance to begin from.

options.name: options
options.description: Configures the set of DHCP options to be included as part of the configured network instance.  This argument accepts a list of values (see suboptions).  When configuring suboptions at least one of C(name) or C(num) must be specified.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: server_association_type
options.description: Configured the type of server association that will be assigned to serve this object instance. This value is not required and will be set as needed automatically during module execution.

options.name: start_addr
options.description: Configures IP address this object instance is to begin from. If 'new_start_addr' is defined during a create operation this value is overridden with the value of 'new_start_addr'

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the intended state of the instance of the object on the NIOS server.  When this value is set to C(present), the object is configured on the device and when this value is set to C(absent) the value is removed (if necessary) from the device.
